## Description
Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update

## Architecture & Code Quality
- [ ] I have followed the **Vertical Slice Architecture** (Features are self-contained).
- [ ] I have defined/updated contracts in `src/shared/`.
- [ ] My code follows the `naming-conventions` defined in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] I have signed my commits (GPG/SSH).

## How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] Manual Test (Dev Mode)
- [ ] Build Test (`npm run build:win` or `build:mac`)
